newsitem.title: USA: US West Coast jet fuel drops late - Oct 10.
newsitem.headline: US West Coast jet fuel drops late - Oct 10.

text.p: U.S. West Coast jet fuel prices dropped in late trade, with supply bolstered by cargoes and pressured by a collapse in futures.
"Jet's getting beaten up in L.A. because of the cargoes," one trader said, referring to Thursday's arrival of a 300,000 barrel cargo, and the imminent docking of a 250,000 barrel supply.
Meanwhile, NYMEX November heating oil fell 3.05 cents a gallon Thursday to 70.92 cents, extending a correction sparked by inventory builds.
